# IKE Doc Maven Plugin

> Maven plugin (prefix idoc:) driving the IKE documentation pipeline:
> AsciiDoctorJ rendering, 6 PDF renderer dispatch, SVG/DocBook
> post-processing, breadcrumb injection, and ike-doc packaging.
